findings.issue: FileSessionStore::ask is a second public send path. The manifest notes say the only run entry points are prepare, run and discover_repo_root. ask loads a session, builds a JudgeRequest, calls validate_for_send, calls judge and emits a log event, all outside run.
findings.recommendation: Either route ask through the engine (a prepared follow-up that run consumes, so the validate/judge/log sequence has one owner), or state in the manifest notes and ADR-SAG-0024 that ask is a second entry point and say why. Share the system-prompt-plus-session-context assembly with run::request_for. Today it is written twice, in session::ask (lines 270-277) and run::request_for (lines 573-577).
findings.evidence: sc-ai command.rs:544 and sc-jev-py run.rs:298 and 787 call sessions.ask directly. run.rs live_run (lines 460-483) repeats the same validate, judge, emit_log sequence. The manifest notes claim a single entry-point set. I found no ADR text in the architecture.md grep that blesses ask as a second path.

findings.issue: lib.rs declares config, equal_input, extract, payload, registry, run and session as `pub mod`. The facade list is much narrower. payload::build_payload, payload::parse_question_set, extract::extract_input, equal_input::producer_from_extractions, config::load_check_str, PACKAGED_SYSTEM_PROMPT, session::StoredSession and others stay public only because in-crate tests import them. The manifest says so itself.
findings.recommendation: Make payload, extract and equal_input `pub(crate)` and move their tests in-crate. Where an integration test truly needs a symbol, put it behind `#[doc(hidden)]` or a `test-util` gate. This removes the public payload builder, which ADR-SAG-0005 and ADR-SAG-0024 say prepare must own.
findings.evidence: tests/cross_impl_branches.rs:12-13 and tests/command.rs:13 import payload, extract and equal_input items directly. Any downstream crate can call build_payload without prepare. That is the parallel assembly path r-2 was meant to delete. The deletion list (PayloadBuilder, build_request and others) is honoured, but the free functions remain reachable.
findings.justification_check: collapsible path (public only for test convenience)

findings.issue: Nothing mechanical ties the `facade` string, which the manifest says is not enforced by sc-lint 0.8.0, to the real pub surface. The manifest's own notes admit about ten pub items outside it, and a prose line is the only check. The facade also lists config::load_check_at, CheckSpec, InputSpec, FileSessionStore and BackendRegistry as facade members, so the facade is broader than the 'only run entry points' wording.
findings.recommendation: Add a public-API snapshot gate (cargo-public-api or a rustdoc-JSON check, with and without test-util) that fails when the pub surface differs from the facade list. Alternatively add an sc-lint TOML policy. Add a gate that `cargo tree -p sc-jev-check -e normal,features` contains no test-util.
findings.evidence: The manifest header and the [references] and [enforcement] comments say only Cargo edges are enforced. The facade drift in F001 and F002 passed without any gate failing.

findings.issue: run::RunResponseBuilder and Envelope plus its constants are listed in the facade. RunResponseBuilder is a test-util-only item sitting in the same flat list as the production facade, and sc-ai re-exports ENVELOPE_VERSION and OP_* (envelope.rs:10, lib.rs:31) as a second public path to the same constants.
findings.recommendation: Split `facade` into production and test-util entries, or mark the test-util items inline. Decide one owner for the Envelope constants: either sc-ai drops its re-export or the docs name it as a deliberate compatibility surface.
findings.evidence: builder.rs is declared as `#[cfg(any(test, feature = "test-util"))] mod builder`. The Envelope and constant moves are justified by ADR-SAG-0024. The sc-ai re-export duplicates the path.
findings.justification_check: justified and retained (Envelope, builder); duplicated path (sc-ai re-export)
